title: How I Go to School
scene: 走路 / 坐公交 / 骑车上学

patterns.template: How do you go to school?

sentences.text: I usually go to school by bus, because my home is far from school.
sentences.gloss: 我通常坐公交车去上学，因为我家离学校很远。

sentences.text: My friend Ben lives near the school, so he often goes by bike.
sentences.gloss: 我的朋友本住在学校附近，所以他常常骑自行车去。

sentences.text: He can ride fast, and he arrives before me.
sentences.gloss: 他能骑得很快，他比我先到。

sentences.text: In the morning I walk to the bus station at the end of my street.
sentences.gloss: 早上我走到我们街尽头的公交车站。

sentences.text: I stand there and wait with the other children.
sentences.gloss: 我站在那里，和其他孩子一起等。

sentences.text: Bus number eight comes, and I get on and show my ticket.
sentences.gloss: 八路公交车来了，我上车，出示我的票。

sentences.text: I find a seat by the window and sit down.
sentences.gloss: 我在窗边找到一个座位，坐下来。

sentences.text: A big truck drives up the road, so our bus is slow today.
sentences.gloss: 一辆大卡车开上马路，所以我们的公交车今天很慢。

sentences.text: That is my way to school. How do you go to school?
sentences.gloss: 这就是我上学的路。你是怎么去上学的呢？
